title: Growth First, Care Second? Tracing the Landscape of LLM Value Preferences in Everyday Dilemmas
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It focuses on characterizing Large Language Model (LLM) value preferences in everyday dilemmas sourced from online communities, centered on general values such as Exploration & Growth, Benevolence & Connection, Security & Stability, and Achievement & Impact.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its analysis is focused on general human values in non-religious contexts (career, friendship, gender-specific advice).
